domain_title: Human impact, rights, fairness, transparency, oversight and recourse
title: Fairness and non-discrimination
canonical_definition: Contextual fairness objectives, relevant groups, data and decision pathways are defined, measured and governed for unacceptable disparity.

conditions: When outcomes may differ materially across protected, vulnerable or otherwise relevant groups.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Are context-specific fairness objectives, relevant groups, harms, metrics and unacceptable thresholds defined?
Are data, model, workflow and human-review mitigations implemented without creating new inequities?
Do subgroup, intersectional and operational results demonstrate acceptable disparity and effective mitigation?

conditions: Refer a material failure of fairness and non-discrimination to the accountable authority before a consequential transition.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MEASURE 2.11 (PDF p. 35), MEASURE 4.1 (PDF p. 36), MAP 5.1 (PDF p. 32)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on evaluating fairness and bias with context-sensitive measurement and impact analysis. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

governance_purpose: Make fairness and non-discrimination verifiable against the current AI system, decision context and accountable ownership.
distinct_claim: E2 evaluates fairness and non-discrimination using evidence from intent through operation. AP-E2 independently assesses evidence of aggregate-performance fairness.

atomic_subcriteria.criterion: The versioned definition identifies a fairness assessment plan covering affected groups, relevant outcomes, disparity measures, sample limits and unacceptable thresholds. Record the accountable owner, scope and material assumptions.

The current release demonstrates mitigations in the data, model and decision workflow with traceable ownership and review for adverse side effects. Trace the decisions and controls to attributable records.

Representative, executed evidence provides subgroup and intersectional results with uncertainty, proxy effects, actual outcomes and mitigation reevaluation. Compare expected and observed outcomes and record exceptions.
For an operating system, current records cover the material paths involved in fairness and non-discrimination, including relevant exceptions and changes.

required_evidence.title: Versioned scope and control definition
required_evidence.description: Provide a fairness assessment plan covering affected groups, relevant outcomes, disparity measures, sample limits and unacceptable thresholds. Include the affected workflow, current version and accountable owner.

required_evidence.title: Effective implementation records
required_evidence.description: Demonstrate mitigations in the data, model and decision workflow with traceable ownership and review for adverse side effects. Trace the scope, control and authority to the current implementation, including exceptions.

required_evidence.title: Representative verification results
required_evidence.description: Provide subgroup and intersectional results with uncertainty, proxy effects, actual outcomes and mitigation reevaluation. Include current version, test scope, criteria, expected and observed outcomes, and unresolved failures.

required_evidence.title: Current operating or change evidence
required_evidence.description: Retain dated records that show how fairness and non-discrimination works for the assessed scope, including the relevant exceptions and any material change since the evidence was captured.

sufficiency: Start with a fairness assessment plan covering affected groups, relevant outcomes, disparity measures, sample limits and unacceptable thresholds. Reconcile it against the effective controls and representative results for the same operating scope and version.

Use subgroup and intersectional results with uncertainty, proxy effects, actual outcomes and mitigation reevaluation to support effectiveness at the relevant lifecycle stage. Record missing paths and unresolved conflicts as UNKNOWN. A verified shortfall can support a gap without resolving the other questions.
Reassess affected evidence after a material change. An accountable human validates or approves the result where required by the lifecycle target.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A specification supports DECLARED intent. Effective implementation records may support IMPLEMENTED. Representative executed tests support TESTED within their scope. Current operating evidence supports OPERATIONALLY_OBSERVED for covered paths and time. Record human assurance independently.
false_positive_guards: Where subgroup evidence is sparse or restricted, record uncertainty and the approved plan for proportionate evaluation.
Reconcile document claims with the effective release, actual operation and relevant exceptions before recording satisfaction.
prohibited_inferences: A capability gap alone cannot establish AP-E2 presence.
An approved design or evidence plan cannot establish test execution or operational effectiveness.
Satisfying this capability cannot by itself authorize progression or establish legal compliance.

finding_definitions.title: Material definition or intent gap in fairness and non-discrimination
Verified implementation or effectiveness gap in fairness and non-discrimination
Evidence remains insufficient for fairness and non-discrimination in the assessed scope
